description: Optimise and personalise your Jabra headset
pre_install: # The download holds a .pkg installer, which spork doesn't run (it needs an admin).
# Unpack all of it into the package folder and keep every file. spork then installs
# Jabra Direct.app, copied from the package whose payload is that bundle
# (com.jabra.directonline), so the unpacked installer stays complete.
echo 'Jabra Direct (com.jabra.directonline) not found in the installer. Packages in it:' >&2
notes: Only the Jabra Direct app is installed. The drivers, kernel extension and login item that
Jabra's installer adds need an admin, so softphone call control and some headset features
may not work. The whole unpacked installer is kept in ~/.spork/apps/jabra-direct/current.
Jabra Direct updates itself; its download has no fixed version, so a new Jabra release
can fail spork's checksum check until this drawer is updated.
